sentence: Be careful! The road is very ___ when it rains.
explanation: RAIN → rainy (se agrega -y para formar un adjetivo que significa 'que tiene lluvia')

sentence: It is a ___ day. The sun is shining.
explanation: SUN → sunny (se duplica la consonante y se agrega -y)

sentence: The sky is very ___ today. I think it will rain.

sentence: She is a very ___ person. She always helps others.

sentence: The garden is ___ in spring with many flowers.

sentence: He is very ___ for your gift.
